messages:
riley.newhire: Hey team, first morning — two things: Okta says I don't have the 'engineering' app available after SSO, and when I try to enroll a security key it errors 'Registration failed'. Also my 1Password invite went to riley.personal@gmail.com by mistake. Who should I ping?
kai-it: Welcome! @it-identity for group mapping. For the key: which device/browser/os?
riley.newhire: MacBook Air M2, macOS 13.6, Chrome stable, YubiKey 5C. I tried Safari too, same error.
it-identity: I don't see you in the 'eng' Google group yet — that would explain the missing app entitlement. I can force a SCIM sync. For the key error, can you paste the exact modal text?
riley.newhire: Modal says 'Registration failed. Please try again. (No details)'.
zoe-devex: Sometimes an org policy requires a platform authenticator vs a security key. Do you have permission to register security keys? We lock that for some OU. @it-identity can check your OU restrictions.
it-identity: I triggered a full SCIM sync for riley@redwood.com — should finish in ~2 minutes. Also I see your account is in the onboarding OU which has security keys allowed, so should be fine. Can you try registering in an Incognito window and paste any browser console errors?
riley.newhire: Incognito gives the same generic error. Console shows: "WebAuthnError: NotAllowedError" when I call navigator.credentials.create().
ai-okta: Okta: Activation email sent to riley@redwood.com at 1783002400.
kai-it: NotAllowedError often means the browser blocked the prompt or a timeout. Try removing any USB hub and plug directly in, and make sure Chrome has site permission for okta.redwood.com to use security keys.
riley.newhire: Plugged direct into USB-C port and cleared site permissions, tried again — now the browser showed the touch prompt but after touching the key it popped 'Registration failed' again.
it-identity: I see the SCIM sync completed and you're now in the eng group. The missing app should appear after you refresh Okta or sign out/in. For the security key, I can temporarily enable TOTP so you don't get blocked. Also I can clear your credential records server-side and let you re-register.
onepassword-bot: 1Password: Invite found for riley.personal@gmail.com. No corporate invite sent yet.
riley.newhire: Thanks — I don't want to be locked out. Please enable TOTP. Also I forwarded the 1Password invite from personal to corporate before realizing; can we resend?
it-identity: TOTP enabled for your account. I cleared existing credential entries for your account and reset the security key registration state. Try the security key flow now. Also I resent the 1Password invite to riley@redwood.com and revoked the personal one.
riley.newhire: Okta now shows 'Enroll security key' flow and after touch it succeeded! Also the eng app showed up after refresh. I accepted the 1Password invite to corporate email.
zoe-devex: Great. Quick policy note: store MFA recovery codes in the company 1Password vault and mark item as restricted if it includes private recovery info. Don't forward corporate invites to personal email in future.
riley.newhire: Saved recovery codes in company vault and removed the forwarded invite from my personal inbox. One more Q: if I want a backup key, do I register it via the same flow?
it-identity: Yes, register the backup as a second security key in your Okta security settings. If you ever swap machines, add the platform authenticator on the new device as well.
riley.newhire: Awesome, registered backup key too. Thanks everyone! Closing out. :party_parrot:
